name: East India Drums and Barrels Manufacturing Ltd

facts.business: East India Drums and Barrels Manufacturing Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of industrial packaging products, offering a comprehensive portfolio of steel drums and related packaging solutions for diverse industries including chemicals, petrochemicals, lubricants, paints, coatings, agrochemicals, and food processing.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets, including capital advances

key_risks: Volatility in steel and other raw material prices
Supply chain disruptions and logistics-related challenges
Intense competition and pricing pressures within the industry
Changes in government policies, environmental regulations and statutory requirements
Inflationary pressures impacting manufacturing and operating costs
Customer concentration and changes in market demand
Foreign exchange fluctuations affecting imported inputs, where applicable
